answer: Copying the same citations across 103 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 103 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because the zenith index resolves every citation against the summit checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the kernel audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 4544 identities would post 4035 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
